dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: 午安。請出示護照。你要托運行李箱嗎？
dialogue.en: Good afternoon. Your passport, please. Are you going to check in a suitcase?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Yes, one suitcase. It is not heavy.

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: 呢張係你嘅登機牌。你嘅登機閘口係十二號。
dialogue.en: Here is your boarding pass. Your gate is number twelve.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Thank you. What time does boarding start?

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: 四十分鐘之後。不過你嘅航班延誤咗二十分鐘。
dialogue.en: In forty minutes. But your flight is delayed by twenty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 冇問題。我喺登機閘口附近等。
dialogue.en: That is fine. I will wait near the gate.
